links.outcome: Zero-shot MVLM performance under clinically plausible pipeline shifts (acquisition, reconstruction, display, delivery) on MRI, chest X-ray, CT
links.effect: CoDA substantially degrades zero-shot performance of CLIP-style MVLMs; chained compositions were consistently more damaging than any single stage. Numbers not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Across brain MRI, chest X-ray, and abdominal CT, CoDA substantially degrades the zero-shot performance of CLIP-style MVLMs, with chained compositions consistently more damaging than any single stage.

unlisted_practices: Post-hoc teacher-guided token-space adaptation with patch-level alignment to repair robustness of vision-language models
Using MLLMs as technical-authenticity auditors of medical image quality

screen.reason: Evaluates medical vision-language model robustness under clinical pipeline shifts (adversarial / realistic pipeline corruptions), tests MLLMs as technical-authenticity audit guardrails, and evaluates a post-hoc token-space repair strategy to safeguard deployed models.
